liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (2 reviews): Reviewer also calls Here Comes Sunshine especially hot; Reviewer recommends listening to Garcia's guitar playing on Sunshine [7][9]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer highlights Garcia's vocals on Terrapin Station [9]
- **The Last Time** (1 review): Reviewer singles out The Last Time as one of the hottest moments of the show [7]

## The recordings

- **gd93-09-21.ST250s.brennecke-young.4532.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 149 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd93-09-21.dsbd.miller.28765.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 140 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the soundboard as a high-quality digital soundboard [12]
- **gd93-09-21.schoeps-byron-dnk.raras.8919.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 152 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1993-09-21.schoeps.wklitz.94669.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the show fell on the last day of summer in New York City [9]
- Reviewer attended this Garden show on their birthday [10]
- Reviewer stood on the floor, fifteenth row; nearby fans sat after Hell In A Bucket and Bertha while they stayed standing [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-09-21.ST250s.brennecke-young.4532.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Clay Brennecke and Jamie Young; source: Audience: AMS ST-250 [1]. Also: Taped by Clay Brennecke and James Young using AMS ST-250 mics in Blumlein, through Apogee AD 500 to D-10 Pro [1]
- **gd93-09-21.dsbd.miller.28765.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 SBD -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD -> EAC -> FLAC [4]. Also: The digital soundboard was remastered by C Miller [12]
- **gd93-09-21.schoeps-byron-dnk.raras.8919.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Eliot Byron; transferred by Jim Raras; source: Audience: Schoeps mk21's [2]
- **gd1993-09-21.schoeps.wklitz.94669.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4's>Rbox>Technics SV-MD1 [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Philip Andelman Grateful Dead: [1993-09-22 Madison Square Garden, New York, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-09-22-madison-square-garden-new-york-ny-usa/) [16]
